reason: The price is fine, maybe even low, but I don't hand my school's student and fee data to a name I've never heard of because a website says so. Nobody has come to the school to show it to my office staff, and it's the middle of the session. I might start the trial, but I won't pay this month.
objection: Will it really do CBSE registration, report cards in the board format and exam-centre work without problems, and will someone pick up the phone during fee collection week when the office is jammed? I can't tell any of that from an online sign-up.
would_change_my_mind: A free demo at my school with my office staff, plus the name of a CBSE school near us that has used it for a full session, and a better price on the per-student charge above 500.
